# vim-ai-follower

> Watch Claude Code type into your own Vim. Open-source Claude Code plugin (Python, MIT, `PreToolUse`/`PostToolUse` hooks, tmux + Neovim backends) that snapshots each file edit, diffs it, and replays it line by line into a real Vim or Neovim pane, at a pace you can actually read, so you can pause it, take the keyboard, and hand it back.

<!-- facts -->800+ unit tests in CI · 100% branch coverage on the full suite · Vim + Neovim backends · v0.2.9<!-- /facts -->

vim-ai-follower is for developers who run Claude Code inside tmux with Vim or Neovim and want to follow each edit as it happens instead of reading a diff afterwards. The default backend types into an unmodified Vim with tmux `send-keys`; the `nvim` backend drives Neovim over msgpack-RPC and can adopt the nvim you already have open. It never writes your files (follower buffers are never saved), its hooks are built to exit 0 and log problems instead, so it never fails a Claude Code tool call, and nothing leaves your machine. The animation does take time; the speed keys and mute are the controls for that, and interrupt hands you the keyboard mid-edit. Built by Alberto Cavalcanti (https://www.linkedin.com/in/albertosca/).

## Docs

- [Install](https://albertosca.github.io/vim-ai-follower/getting-started/install/): requirements, the Claude Code plugin install, the manual install with hand-wired hooks
- [Follow your first edit](https://albertosca.github.io/vim-ai-follower/getting-started/first-follow/): start the follower from Claude Code and watch an edit animate
- [Pause, take over, speed and mute](https://albertosca.github.io/vim-ai-follower/guides/controls/): the tmux prefix keys P, S, +, _ and F
- [Multi-file tabs](https://albertosca.github.io/vim-ai-follower/guides/multi-file-tabs/): one Vim tab per file, recency-ordered, capped at max_tabs
- [Adopting an editor](https://albertosca.github.io/vim-ai-follower/guides/adopting-an-editor/): let the follower drive the Vim you already have open, and its risks
- [Neovim backend](https://albertosca.github.io/vim-ai-follower/guides/nvim-backend/): drive Neovim over msgpack-RPC, adopt or launch
- [Command line](https://albertosca.github.io/vim-ai-follower/reference/cli/): claude-follow subcommands, start flags, slash commands
- [Configuration](https://albertosca.github.io/vim-ai-follower/reference/config/): config.json keys and defaults
- [Keybindings](https://albertosca.github.io/vim-ai-follower/reference/keybindings/): the tmux prefix keys and who owns them
- [Engineering](https://albertosca.github.io/vim-ai-follower/engineering/): how it works, five design decisions and their trade-offs, with commits and tests
- [FAQ](https://albertosca.github.io/vim-ai-follower/faq/): does it slow Claude down, does it touch my files, what leaves the machine, limitations

## Source

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/albertosca/vim-ai-follower): code, issues; installed through the Claude Code plugin marketplace (`/plugin marketplace add albertosca/vim-ai-follower`)
